You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. hophr-hophr:lever:5a729a3a-8697-414b-929.description: We're hiring an HPC Sr Staff Engineer, Test Jig Core Technology Development for a global semiconductor company developing flagship automotive SoCs — large-scale chips integrating CPU, cache, memory, high-speed interfaces, AI, video, functional safety, and security — powering the intelligence and electrification of next-generation vehicles. About the role In the automotive sector's New Product Introduction (NPI) area, optimizing test quality and test costs with a view to products to be released several years from now is a crucial challenge. Therefore, it is necessary to investigate, select, and evaluate new technologies and test equipment, and to establish test methodologies applicable to future products as part of the company's DCP (Design/Development Control Process). These efforts are essential for differentiating ourselves from competitors, ensuring competitiveness, and promoting DIN (Design Inventory) to a superior position. This field requires not only the development of test technologies but also comprehensive solutions encompassing equipment selection and cost management. Therefore, engineers in this role need extensive experience and knowledge in various areas, including test technology, product understanding, equipment, and cost management. They play a vital role directly linked to securing future profits and are highly valued by related departments. However, currently, there is only one dedicated engineer, making the securing of resources for the evaluation and development of next-generation products and the planned transfer of technology and know-how through on-the-job training an urgent issue. Against this backdrop, this recruitment is aimed at securing and developing the next generation of talent to lead this field.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2729318f-05d3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI & Data Engineer based in India. This role offers the opportunity to build the next generation of intelligent, agentic AI systems that can reason, retrieve information, and execute complex workflows. You will work at the intersection of generative AI, data engineering, and production software development. The position involves transforming structured and unstructured data into reliable, actionable intelligence for advanced AI applications. You will design and deploy RAG pipelines, AI agents, semantic search capabilities, and scalable data platforms. The environment combines experimentation with strong production engineering standards, including CI/CD and ML observability. You will collaborate on emerging AI technologies while contributing to systems designed for real-world enterprise use. This is a fully remote opportunity with significant scope for technical growth, innovation, and impact. Design, build, and deploy AI-driven applications and agentic systems capable of reasoning, information retrieval, and complex workflow execution. Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex. Work with large language models and transformer-based architectures, including GPT, Gemini, and Claude, applying advanced prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and context-window optimization techniques. Build semantic search and vector-based retrieval layers using technologies such as PGVector, embedding models, and Google indexing capabilities. Process and transform large-scale datasets using Python, Pandas, PySpark, or Scala to support AI and data-intensive applications. Design high-performance SQL solutions and scalable data warehouse architectures using platforms such as Snowflake or Redshift. Create dimensional data models optimized for low-latency AI consumption, scalability, and strong data quality. Develop clean, maintainable, production-ready software supported by robust CI/CD practices and ML observability. Explore advanced AI architectures, including multi-agent systems, multimodal applications, and long-context use cases. Contribute to the deployment and scaling of AI workloads in cloud environments, with opportunities to work across AWS and Google AI ecosystems. Requirements: 5+ years of relevant professional experience in AI engineering, data engineering, machine learning, software engineering, or a closely related technical field. 2+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI-driven applications, with strong expertise in RAG pipelines and AI agents. Strong understanding of transformer architectures and practical experience working with modern LLMs such as GPT, Gemini, or Claude. Proven experience with advanced prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, context optimization, embeddings, and semantic search. Strong data engineering capabilities, including experience processing large datasets with Python, Pandas, PySpark, or Scala. Professional experience with Snowflake or Redshift and the ability to write advanced, performance-oriented SQL. Strong data modeling skills, particularly in designing dimensional models for high-quality, low-latency AI workloads. Experience writing clean, maintainable production code and implementing CI/CD and ML observability practices. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Experience with multi-agent systems, AWS services such as Bedrock and Lambda, or Google Gemini for multimodal and long-context applications is highly desirable. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f6245353-247e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Netherlands. This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations. You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working. The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement. You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum. A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption. You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives. This is an opportunity for an experienced change leader to make a measurable impact across complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs. Develop and implement comprehensive Organizational Change Management strategies aligned with transformation objectives, project timelines, and business outcomes. Conduct stakeholder impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and change impact analyses to identify affected groups, risks, and adoption requirements. Establish and manage change networks, champion programs, and stakeholder engagement structures that support sustained adoption. Design and execute communication strategies, including executive toolkits, targeted messaging, leadership communications, and employee engagement materials. Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels. Define appropriate OCM governance frameworks, roles, processes, and decision-making structures for large-scale transformation programs. Create or contribute to comprehensive training strategies that prepare employees for new systems, processes, and operating models. Manage key change deliverables, including readiness assessments, management toolkits, communication materials, training plans, and adoption metrics. Monitor change-related risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans throughout implementation. Track adoption and organizational readiness metrics, using insights to adjust change strategies and improve transformation outcomes. Collaborate effectively with client teams, consulting partners, complementary service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated delivery. Requirements Proven experience leading Organizational Change Management initiatives for large-scale ERP or technology-enabled business transformation programs. Strong knowledge of SAP platforms, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred, and an understanding of the related business processes and transformation impacts. Demonstrated experience developing change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement frameworks. Strong knowledge of organizational design, transition planning, and change impact analysis. Experience working within or supporting manufacturing organizations is required. Excellent facilitation, presentation, communication, and collaboration skills across executive, management, and operational levels. Ability to build effective working relationships across client organizations, consulting teams, technology teams, and external partners. Strong ability to manage multiple change workstreams, deliverables, risks, and stakeholders within complex transformation environments. Experience participating in at least five major business change initiatives involving SAP or comparable ERP platforms is preferred.
